title: Accepted outcome
decision: Define the human result and denominator before agent activity
alternative: Keep a human-led baseline with sampled acceptance before introducing automation.
failure_to_test: Plausible output that fails the actual task
required_artifact: Frozen cases, acceptance owner, result ledger
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Model seam
decision: Separate provider credentials, transport and capability policy
alternative: Use one direct provider integration while documenting the deliberate lock-in and migration boundary.
failure_to_test: Fallback changes privacy or tool behavior
required_artifact: Provider adapter contract and differential eval
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Context contract
decision: Admit sources by rights, purpose, freshness and user access
alternative: Use a curated static corpus with human publication approval instead of live retrieval.
failure_to_test: Unauthorized or obsolete retrieval
required_artifact: Source ledger, ACL cases and deletion propagation
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Workflow versus agent
decision: Use a fixed workflow until decisions require open reasoning
alternative: Use a deterministic state machine when the route and tool set can be specified.
failure_to_test: Autonomous detours inflate cost without value
required_artifact: Baseline comparison and bounded stop rule
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Durable execution
decision: Persist effects and checkpoints beyond request life
alternative: Use a short synchronous request when no durable side effect or long-running job is needed.
failure_to_test: Duplicate action after restart or timeout
required_artifact: Idempotency key, restart and cancellation tests
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Tool authority
decision: Trusted gateway checks actor, tenant, input and resource
alternative: Use read-only tools and explicit human execution for consequential effects.
failure_to_test: Prompt injection expands permissions
required_artifact: Typed tool contracts and denial fixtures
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Customer experience
decision: Make progress, correction, stop and export visible
alternative: Use a guided form with previews and explicit approval instead of a conversational interface.
failure_to_test: Attractive screen conceals stale/failing work
required_artifact: Service blueprint and tested interaction states
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Topology
decision: One ID registry backs every component and edge
alternative: Use a versioned static component diagram when collaborative graph editing has no customer value.
failure_to_test: Diagram and deployment describe different systems
required_artifact: Canonical graph and semantic export checks
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Data flow
decision: Classify every transferred payload and trust crossing
alternative: Minimize transfers and compute beside the governed data instead of copying the corpus.
failure_to_test: Trace captures personal data or secrets
required_artifact: Data inventory, access tests, trace redaction
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Human review
decision: Bind review to exact artifacts and decision rights
alternative: Use automated policy checks only for reversible low-impact actions with a measured error budget.
failure_to_test: Review applies to a changed release
required_artifact: Immutable receipt and change invalidation
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Cost per accepted result
decision: Count failures, retries, review and support
alternative: Keep the manual baseline if total accepted-result cost exceeds the value created.
failure_to_test: Cheap inference hides expensive correction
required_artifact: Full-attempt cost ledger and baseline
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Consumption
decision: Attribute actual billable workload usage
alternative: Track customer value alone when provider workload metering is unavailable; leave consumption unknown.
failure_to_test: Credits/API resale counted as platform demand
required_artifact: Metered service/account/region ledger
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Provider portability
decision: Define the export boundary and replacement test
alternative: Accept a managed proprietary service when its time-to-value benefit exceeds a quantified exit cost.
failure_to_test: Claimed neutrality fails on proprietary state
required_artifact: Export/import and adapter contract cases
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Operational readiness
decision: Name owner, SLO, alert, recovery and teardown
alternative: Keep the system as a sandbox until an operating owner and recovery evidence exist.
failure_to_test: READY deployment cannot complete customer journey
required_artifact: Domain/revision receipt and incident drill
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Intelligence level
decision: Select deterministic, assistive, workflow or bounded agent
alternative: Use a single model call with structured output before adding tools, memory or delegation.
failure_to_test: Extra agents only add latency and agreement bias
required_artifact: Controlled comparative evaluation
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Research provenance
decision: Separate fact, inference, proposal and uncertainty
alternative: Publish an explicit unverified proposal when primary evidence is unavailable.
failure_to_test: Agent-written certainty outruns sources
required_artifact: Claim/source ledger and expiry dependency map
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Visual evidence
decision: Select exact code/spec diagrams or conceptual generated media
alternative: Use conceptual generated imagery for narrative scenes; use code for exact topology.
failure_to_test: Wrong icon or arrow changes meaning
required_artifact: Format policy, icon registry and export review
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Industry solution
decision: Ground use case in observed work and sector constraints
alternative: Use a horizontal solution only after proving the sector has no additional workflow or data requirements.
failure_to_test: Generic automation misses actual operating needs
required_artifact: Current industry sources and customer pilot
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Partner status
decision: Distinguish upstream project, target and signed relationship
alternative: List an upstream dependency or candidate openly until an authorized relationship is documented.
failure_to_test: Logo falsely suggests endorsement
required_artifact: Agreement/status/expiry record
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation

title: Invention status
decision: Distinguish original proposal, benchmarked contribution and legal claim
alternative: Reuse an existing upstream pattern when prior-art review finds the proposed mechanism already established.
failure_to_test: Combination presented as patented novelty
required_artifact: Prior-art investigation and independent experiment
source_role: contextual-reading; authored prescription, not external validation
